value.name: Adar Tallon
value.text: After you resolve a [Squadron] command, exhaust this card to toggle the activation slider of 1 squadron activated with that command.

value.name: Admiral Chiraneau
value.text: [Squadron]: Squadrons that you activate can move even if they are engaged. When an engaged squadron moves in this way, treat it as having a printed speed of "2."

value.name: Admiral Montferrat
value.text:
While defending against a ship, if your speed is 3 or higher, the attack is treated as obstructed.
After you execute a maneuver, if you overlapped a ship, discard this card.

value.name: Admiral Ozzel
value.text: At the start of the first round, you may execute a speed-1 maneuver.

value.name: Admiral Titus
value.text: At the start of the first round, you may change 1 enemy ship's speed by 1.

value.name: Agent Kallus
value.text: While attacking a unique squadron, add 1 die of any color to your attack pool.

value.name: Ahsoka Tano
value.text: During the activation of a friendly ship at distance 1-5, you may exhaust this card to discard 1 command token from that ship. If you do, that ship may gain 1 command token of any type.

value.name: Bail Organa
value.text: After deploying fleets, you may place 1 round token on this card. At the start of the Ship Phase of the round matching that round token, if you are the second player you must activate, if you are the first player, you may gain up to 2 command tokens of your choice.

value.name: Captain Brunson
value.text: While defending at distance 1-2 of an obstacle, during the Spend Defense Tokens step, you may exhaust this card to choose and cancel 1 attack die.

value.name: Captain Needa
value.text: At the start of the first round, you may replace 1 of your defense tokens with an [Evade] defense token.

value.name: Captain Rex
value.text: [Squadron]: You may choose 1 enemy ship at close range. That ship gains 1 raid token of your choice. While you are at distance 1-3 of an enemy ship, that ship can discard only 1 raid token of any type when it discards a command dial.

value.name: Chart Officer
value.text: After you execute a maneuver, if you overlapped an obstacle, you may discard this card instead of resolving the effects of overlapping that obstacle.

value.name: Commandant Aresko
value.text: When another friendly ship at distance 1-3 reveals a command, you may exhaust this card to gain 1 command token of the same type.

value.name: Commander Beck
value.text: During your activation, you may resolve a command as if you had spent a command token. If you do, gain 1 raid token of the matching type. You may resolve this effect twice per activation.

value.name: Commander Gherant
value.text: While you are defending, the attacker cannot resolve critical effects. After you perform an attack against a ship, discard this card.

value.name: Commander Vanto
value.text: After you resolve the first command during your activation, you may exhaust this card to gain 1 command token of any type.

value.name: Commander Woldar
value.text: While a friendly, non-[Swarm] squadron at distance 1-3 is attacking a squadron, it may reroll 1 die of any color.

value.name: Damage Control Officer
value.text: When you resolve the [Contain] defense effect, you can prevent the attacker from resolving any critical effects.

value.name: Darth Vader
value.text: While a friendly ship at distance 1-5 is attacking a ship, it may discard 1 of its [Commander] or [Officer] cards (other than Darth Vader) to reroll any number of dice in its attack pool.

value.name: Defense Liaison
value.text: Before you reveal a command, you may spend 1 command token to change that command to a [Navigate] or [Repair] command.

value.name: Director Isard
value.text: When you reveal a command, you may look at all command dials assigned to 1 enemy ship.

value.name: Director Krennic
value.text: [Concentrate Fire]: While attacking at medium-long range, if you spent a [Concentrate Fire] dial, you may also reroll any number of red dice in your attack pool. If you spent a [Concentrate Fire] token, you may also reroll up to 2 red dice in your attack pool.

value.name: Emperor Palpatine
value.text: When an enemy ship or unique squadron declares you as the target of an attack, it must spend 1 of its defense tokens (if able).

value.name: Engineering Captain
value.text: Before you reveal a command, you may change that command to a [Repair] command.

value.name: Expert Shield Tech
value.text: While defending, during the Spend Defense Tokens step, when you spend a [Redirect] defense token, you may reduce the total damage from the attack by 1 instead of resolving that token's effect.

value.name: Ezra Bridger
value.text: When you reveal a command, you may discard this card to move 1 obstacle at distance 1-2 so that it is within distance 1-2 of its current location.

value.name: Flight Commander
value.text: During your activation, you can resolve your [Squadron] command after you execute a maneuver.

value.name: General Draven
value.text: While attacking a squadron with Counter or Intel, add 1 die of any color to your attack pool.

value.name: Governor Pryce
value.text: After deploying fleets, you may place 1 round token on this card. If you do, during the round matching that round token, you must activate at the end of the Ship Phase (after all other ships have activated).

value.name: Hondo Ohnaka
value.text: At the start of the ship phase, you may discard this card to choose 2 different command tokens and place them on 2 different ships. Then your opponent chooses 2 different command tokens you did not choose and places them on 2 different ships.

value.name: Iden Versio
value.text: When you resolve the [Evade] defense effect, you can cancel 1 die at close range or distance 1. [Squadron]: You may discard this card to choose 1 enemy ship at close range. That ship gains 1 raid token of your choice.

value.name: Instructor Goran
value.text: While a friendly non-Heavy squadron is at distance 1-2, it has Counter 1 or increases its Counter value by 1.

value.name: Intel Officer
value.text: While attacking, after you roll your attack pool, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 defense token. If that token is spent during this attack, discard that token.

value.name: Kyrsta Agate
value.text: Red or Blue [Critical Hit]: You may exhaust this card to ready 1 of your exhausted defense tokens. You can resolve this critical effect during a [Salvo] attack.

value.name: Lando Calrissian
value.text: While defending, during the Spend Defense Tokens Step, you may discard this card to force the attacker to reroll 1 or more dice of your choice.

value.name: Leia Organa
value.text: When you reveal a command, you may choose another friendly ship at distance 1-5 and change that ship's top command to your revealed command.

value.name: Lira Wessex
value.text: When you are dealt a faceup damage card, you may spend 1 [Repair] token to flip that card facedown (without resolving its effect).

value.name: Major Derlin
value.text: Before you suffer damage from an attack, you may exhaust this card to reduce the total damage by 1.

value.name: Minister Tua
value.text:
You gain an additional [Defensive Retrofit] icon in your upgrade bar.
You cannot equip this card to a medium or large ship with a [Defensive Retrofit] icon in its upgrade bar.

value.name: Navigation Officer
value.text: Before you reveal a command, you may change that command to a [Navigate] command.

value.name: Raymus Antilles
value.text: When you reveal a command, you may gain 1 matching command token without spending the command dial.

value.name: Reeva Demesne
value.text: After you are declared as the target of an attack, if the defending hull zone has at least 1 shield remaining, you may exhaust this card to ready 1 defense token.

value.name: Sabine Wren
value.text: At the start of the Ship Phase, you may discard this card to place 1 proximity mine token in the play area at distance 1-2 of an obstacle and beyond distance 3 of enemy ships.

value.name: Skilled First Officer
value.text: Before you reveal a command, you may discard this card to discard your top command dial.

value.name: Strategic Adviser
value.text: When it is your turn to activate, you may exhaust this card to pass your turn (your opponent activates a ship instead).

value.name: Support Officer
value.text: At the start of the Command Phase, you may discard this card to discard all of your command dials.

value.name: Tactical Expert
value.text: Before you reveal a command, you may change that command to a [Concentrate Fire] command.

value.name: Taskmaster Grint
value.text: After deploying fleets, choose and place 1 command token on this card. When you reveal a command matching that token, you may gain 1 matching command token without spending the command dial.

value.name: The Grand Inquisitor
value.text: When an enemy ship at distance 1-5 changes its speed, you may exhaust this card to increase or decrease your speed by 1.

value.name: Toryn Farr
value.text: While another friendly ship or squadron at distance 1-3 is attacking, it may reroll 1 blue die.

value.name: Veteran Captain
value.text: When you reveal a command, you may discard this card to gain 1 command token of your choice.

value.name: Walex Blissex
value.text: When you activate, you may discard this card to recover 1 of your discarded defense tokens.

value.name: Weapons Liaison
value.text: Before you reveal a command, you may spend 1 command token to change that command to a [Concentrate Fire] or [Squadron] command.

value.name: Wedge Antilles
value.text: Before the end of the Squadron Phase, you may spend 1 [Squadron] token to choose up to 3 friendly non-unique squadrons without [Strategic] at distance 1-5. Those squadrons gain [Cloak] until the end of the round.

value.name: Wing Commander
value.text: Before you reveal a command, you may change that command to a [Squadron] command.

value.name: Wulff Yularen
value.text: When you spend a command token, you may exhaust this card to gain 1 command token of the same type.

value.name: Clone Captain Zak
value.text: While attacking from your left or right hull zone, or your rear hull zone, you may exhaust this card to add 1 die of a color already in your attack pool. You cannot add a die to a Salvo attack.

value.text: At the start of the first round and the fifth round, each friendly ship may gain a number of command tokens equal to its command value.

value.text: While a friendly ship is attacking a ship, if the attack is obstructed by a ship or obstacle, the attacker does not remove a die (even if the attack is also obstructed by a card effect), and may add 1 red die to the attack pool.

value.name: General Tagge
value.text: At the start of the third round and the fifth round, each friendly ship may recover 1 of its discarded defense tokens.

value.text: After deploying fleets, place 3 facedown command dials on this card. At the start of each Ship Phase, you may reveal and discard 1 of those dials. If you do, until the end of the round, before each friendly ship activates, it gains 1 additional dial matching that discarded dial.

value.name: Grand Moff Tarkin
value.text: At the start of each Ship Phase, you may choose 1 command. Each friendly ship gains a command token matching that command.

value.text: After you deploy, gain 1 non-[Scatter] defense token. During your "Spend Defense Tokens" step, if your speed is not 0, you may discard 1 defense token to resolve the effect of that defense token. You cannot resolve the effect of each type of defense token more than once per attack.

value.name: Leia Organa
value.text: When a friendly ship resolves a command by spending a command dial, if it has not resolved another command this round, it may resolve that command as if it spent a matching command token. If it does, that ship may not resolve additional commands this round.

value.text: During a friendly ship's Determine Course step, it may suffer 1 damage to change the first yaw value of its current speed to "||" until the end of its activation.

value.text: When a friendly ship resolves the [Evade] token effect, it can cancel 1 die at medium range or reroll 1 die at close range or distance 1.
